content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. Let me actually say what I mean.

A birthday morning walking the water with no phone, feeling hopeful for the first time in months, that's worth more than a passing line. That sounds like real relief after the stretch you've been in.

And telling your team you need two weeks, after running on empty for this long, that's not a small thing to say out loud. Good for you."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
